question: In a common rail direct injection (CRDI) diesel system, what is the primary function of the high-pressure accumulator rail?
options: To filter fuel before injection
To maintain a constant high fuel pressure available for all injectors simultaneously
To regulate the quantity of fuel delivered per stroke
To cool the fuel before it reaches the injectors

question: When diagnosing an ABS fault, the wheel speed sensor signal shows a flat line on the oscilloscope during wheel rotation. Which fault is MOST likely indicated?
options: Intermittent open circuit in the ABS control module
Complete loss of signal due to excessive air gap or open circuit in the sensor
A shorted tone ring causing signal inversion
Incorrect reluctor ring tooth count programmed in the ECU

question: A vehicle equipped with a Variable Valve Timing (VVT) system shows a fault code for 'camshaft position over-retarded'. Which component failure would MOST likely cause this condition?
options: A faulty crankshaft position sensor
A blocked oil control valve (OCV) solenoid preventing oil flow to the phaser
A worn timing chain causing excessive stretch advancing the cam
A failed throttle position sensor providing incorrect load data

question: During a four-wheel alignment procedure, the technician finds excessive negative camber on one front wheel with all other angles within specification. Which component is MOST likely worn or damaged?
options: Tie rod end on the affected side
Strut bearing plate on the affected side
Lower control arm ball joint on the affected side
Rack and pinion steering gear

question: In an electronically controlled automatic transmission, the torque converter clutch (TCC) fails to engage at highway speeds. After confirming normal line pressure, which system should be checked NEXT?
options: The governor valve spring tension
The TCC solenoid duty cycle signal and TCC solenoid resistance
The pump output pressure at idle
The planetary gear set end-play clearance

question: A technician performing a cylinder leakage test finds 45% leakage on cylinder 3, with air escaping from the radiator filler neck. What does this MOST likely indicate?
options: Worn piston rings on cylinder 3
A cracked exhaust valve on cylinder 3
A blown head gasket between cylinder 3 and a coolant passage
A cracked cylinder wall causing combustion gas ingestion

question: Which of the following BEST describes the function of the lambda (oxygen) sensor in a closed-loop engine management system?
options: It measures the mass of air entering the intake manifold to calculate injection duration
It provides feedback to the ECU to correct the air-fuel ratio toward stoichiometry by detecting residual oxygen in exhaust gases
It directly controls injector pulse width based on throttle position
It monitors coolant temperature to enrich the mixture during warm-up

question: A brake pedal sinks slowly to the floor under steady pressure but returns to normal height when released. The most probable cause is:
options: Air in the brake hydraulic system
A seized brake caliper piston
An internal leak past the master cylinder secondary cup seal
Contaminated brake fluid reducing boiling point

question: In a rack and pinion power steering system with electro-hydraulic assistance, the steering feels heavy at low speeds but normal at high speeds. The MOST likely cause is:
options: A faulty vehicle speed sensor sending incorrect data to the power steering control module
Low power steering fluid level causing cavitation only under full lock
A worn rack and pinion causing excessive mechanical friction at low loads
A defective steering angle sensor causing over-correction at high speed

question: When testing a piezoelectric fuel injector using a lab scope, the technician observes a missing voltage spike at the end of the injection event on one injector. This indicates:
options: The injector is opening correctly but closing too slowly
The piezoelectric stack is not discharging properly, suggesting internal injector failure
Excessive rail pressure forcing the injector closed prematurely
A faulty injector driver circuit causing delayed opening

question: A vehicle with a dual-mass flywheel (DMF) exhibits a rattling noise at idle that disappears above 1200 RPM. This symptom MOST likely indicates:
options: Worn clutch friction disc lining
Failure of the DMF spring and damper mechanism losing torsional damping at resonance frequency
A loose exhaust heat shield resonating at idle
Worn transmission input shaft bearing

question: During a charging system test, the alternator output voltage is 13.1V at 2000 RPM with all loads on. The battery voltage is 12.4V at rest. What condition does this MOST accurately describe?
options: Normal charging system operation under heavy load
An undercharging condition likely caused by a worn carbon brush assembly or faulty voltage regulator
An overcharging condition that will damage the battery
Normal open-circuit voltage indicating a fully charged battery

question: A technician is diagnosing an EVAP system for a large leak (P0455). After pressurizing the system with a smoke machine, smoke is observed coming from the purge solenoid valve. The NEXT correct diagnostic step is:
options: Replace the charcoal canister immediately
Command the purge solenoid open using a scan tool and retest to determine if the leak is through or around the solenoid
Replace the fuel filler cap as it is the most common EVAP leak point
Clear the code and perform a drive cycle to confirm the fault

question: In a semi-trailing arm independent rear suspension, excessive toe-out on one side during braking is MOST likely caused by:
options: Worn front control arm bushings
Deteriorated semi-trailing arm pivot bushings allowing geometry change under longitudinal load
Incorrect rear wheel static toe setting
A bent rear axle stub shaft

question: A hybrid electric vehicle's high-voltage battery management system (BMS) isolates the battery pack and sets a fault code for 'isolation loss'. What is the CORRECT initial safety procedure before beginning diagnosis?
options: Remove the 12V auxiliary battery to disable all systems
Locate and remove the high-voltage service disconnect plug and verify zero voltage using a CAT III rated multimeter before touching any HV components
Simply clear the fault code and test drive the vehicle to see if the fault returns
Discharge the HV battery by turning the vehicle on and off several times
